fullName.value: Nuclear localization signal-containing protein deleted in velocardiofacial syndrome

texts.value: Component of the mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit (mt-LSU) (PubMed:25278503, PubMed:25838379, PubMed:28892042). Mature mammalian 55S mitochondrial ribosomes consist of a small (28S) and a large (39S) subunit. The 28S small subunit contains a 12S ribosomal RNA (12S mt-rRNA) and 30 different proteins. The 39S large subunit contains a 16S rRNA (16S mt-rRNA), a copy of mitochondrial valine transfer RNA (mt-tRNA(Val)), which plays an integral structural role, and 52 different proteins. mL40 binds to the major groove of the anticodon stem of mt-tRNA(Val) in the central protuberance
Belongs to the mitochondrion-specific ribosomal protein mL40 family
